limits: Only the notebook held in this browser.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lists the user's own notebook entries; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which lab-notebook entries match this search, newest first?

description: Your lab-notebook entries, newest first — id, title, tags, collection, when they changed, and the @plasmid / !action / &gel cross-references each one names. Filter by a tag, by collection, or by text in the title and body, so a run can find the entry it is continuing instead of starting a second one about the same experiment.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

collection.description: only entries filed in this collection.

limit.description: how many entries to return, newest first.

search.description: match on title or body text, case-insensitively. Left unset, every entry is listed.

name: list_experiments

collections.description: every collection you have, with how many entries it holds

count.description: how many matched — branch on this rather than counting the array

entries.description: the matching entries: id, title, tags, collection, created_at, updated_at, the three cross-reference lists and the body length. The BODY itself is not here — a notebook is long and a listing is for finding, so read one with the id this gives you

total.description: how many entries the notebook holds in all, so a filter that matched nothing can say whether the notebook is empty or the filter was wrong
